svg.text: L2 · IO-PWR — Checklist jalur PCB (pad → pad) D03
Board industrial gas · AC / gas / VFD · clearances HV · Fase 1 tidak diganti modul
A. AC + GAS MASTER
☐ AC → EMI1 → PSU1 / F_MAIN · E-Stop NC#1 di harness
☐ F_MAIN → L_MAINS · N_MAINS / AC_N sesuai desain
☐ K_GAS (LC1D09BD 24V) + GX103 NC seri coil interlock
☐ Q_GAS gate ← GAS_EN (J9.5) · pulldown · D_GAS flyback
☐ Separation AC/gas HV ↔ LV logic ≥ clearance KiCad DRC
Coil K_GAS = 24VDC — BUKAN contactor 12V
J_GAS L/N ke katup · PE stud bonding
B. PSU 24V (+ aux 12V)
☐ AC → EMI → PSU1 → +24V_BUS · F_CTRL
☐ +24V → E-Stop NC#2 → coils + J9.1 ke MAIN
☐ PSU GND → GND · J_PE ← PE
☐ PSU2 / +12V_AUX untuk pump cabang (jika dipakai)
☐ J9.1 continuous ke MAIN U3 VIN (+24V_IN)
FG / PE bonding < 0.1 Ω di assembly
MAIN FIXED 5V makan dari +24V — bukan 12V mindset
C. DC LOADS / VFD / RELAY
☐ J9.6 VFD_D_RUN → REL_VFD_D · J9.7 VFD_F_RUN → REL_VFD_F
☐ J9.8 AGIT_EN → Q_AGIT / K3 · J9.9 COOL → Q_COOL / K4
☐ J9.10 PUMP_EN → Q_PUMP · flyback dioda dekat coil/FET
☐ J9.11/12 DAC → U20 level-shift → 0–10V VFD AI
☐ Gate pulldown semua EN (boot safe OFF)
Terminal field wiring di tepi · silk cocok harness
D. J9 PIN MAP (IO side)
1 +24V_BUS → MAIN · 2 GND · 4 GND_SIG
5 GAS_EN · 6 VFD_D · 7 VFD_F · 8 AGIT
9 COOL_FAN · 10 PUMP · 11 DAC_D · 12 DAC_F
13 +5V sense (opsional) · 3/14–20 NC/spare
Place J9 mirror ke MAIN supaya ribbon pendek lurus
Silk J9 pin1 = +24V (segitiga) — SALAH = rusak MAIN
E. Urutan layout IO
AC/EMI/PSU → gas contactor · VFD relays · DC loads · J9 tepi ke MAIN
DRC: HV clearance AC/gas ↔ LV · hole · edge · lalu Gerber IO
Prioritas junior: J9.1 +24V continuous ke FIXED 5V · K_GAS LC1D09BD 24V
Ref: D03_Electrical_System_Design.md · gen_pcb_layout.py · pcb_nets.py · BOM K_GAS LC1D09BD
IO locked Fase 1 — fokus clearances + pin1 +24V ke MAIN
